title: Optional: Crashbreak Relay Proof
briefing: Crashbreak will pay for proof that the relay route is safe enough for salvage crews. This is a small field contract, not a full faction commitment.

objectives.label: Scan the Crashbreak contract board
objectives.detail: Confirm the contract is optional and tied to relay route proof.

objectives.label: Log relay proof
objectives.detail: Record the relay route state and cache result in Terminal Route Records.

objectives.label: Claim contract support
objectives.detail: Reward should support route progression with power cells, scrap metal, or scanner supplies.

rewards.label: Power cell, scrap metal, and route note support
rewards.detail: Power cell, scrap metal, and route note support appears in Terminal rewards and route records so the payoff is readable before claiming it.

rewards.label: Crashbreak field proof
rewards.detail: Crashbreak field proof appears in Terminal rewards and route records so the payoff is readable before claiming it.

completionText: Crashbreak relay proof logged. The contract stays optional and should not block the main Ashfall route.
fieldGuide: Optional Crashbreak relay contract that rewards route proof without blocking the main relay route or starting a full faction arc.
